guidance_notes: EPA 1633A — PTFE and fluoropolymer PFAS contamination awareness; encode workflow flags not a substitute for lab SOP
PFAS in tubing/fittings — use validated low-background paths per method
PFAS in reagents — lot verification and blank evidence
PFAS in glassware — cleaning discipline tied to method blanks
Personal care / consumer product PFAS — field hygiene; audit metadata only
